name: At the Mountains of Madness
summary: A game in active development. Its intended visual direction: watercolor, restrained psychological horror, and an Antarctic expedition dwarfed by monumental ancient ruins.
visualNote: Concept art created for the project to set its intended visual direction and atmosphere. It is not a gameplay screenshot or in-engine render, and does not show content already implemented in the game.

cover.alt: Watercolor concept art of an Antarctic expedition crossing a frozen landscape toward monumental ancient ruins in the mountains.
cover.caption: Concept art — Antarctic expedition approaching the ancient ruins. Watercolor visual direction for At the Mountains of Madness.
